title: Residency Call Scheduling Software | Done For You
description: Residency call scheduling software that takes the burden off the chief. We are a managed service: send us your rules and we deliver a fair call schedule, built to the ACGME rules.
paragraph: Scheduling Wizard is a managed service, not complex software. Submit your rules and get a fair, ACGME-compliant residency call schedule.

cta.title: Stop Building Call Schedules by Hand
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard is not traditional self-service call scheduling software; it is a managed service. Rather than giving your chief residents a tool to learn and operate, Scheduling Wizard accepts your program's rules and delivers the finished call schedule as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you. There is no platform to log into, no training required, and no annual retraining when chiefs rotate out.
faq.question: What is residency call scheduling software and how does Scheduling Wizard differ?

faq.answer: We apply the ACGME rules while the call schedule is built rather than checking it afterwards: the 80-hour weekly limit, rest requirements between shifts, the 24-hour cap and the subspecialty-specific rules for your program. We work from the requirements your program tells us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure ACGME duty hour compliance in call schedules?

faq.answer: Yes. You tell us which requirements apply to your program, the Common Program Requirements and anything your specialty's Review Committee adds, and we write them down with you alongside your own rules before the first build. They go into the schedule while it is built rather than being flagged afterwards.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard handle call schedules for my specific medical subspecialty?

faq.answer: Yes, and many Scheduling Wizard clients use exactly this combination. Scheduling Wizard handles the building of your call schedule. The finished schedule is delivered as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, ready for whatever platform you already uses for day-to-day schedule access. You do not need to change your existing viewing workflow.
faq.question: Will Scheduling Wizard work alongside your existing platform?

faq.answer: Mid-year changes such as sick leave, emergency absences, or a rotation change are handled as part of the managed service. Day-to-day swaps between two residents stay with the program; we rebuild when the change is bigger than that. Those rebuilds are handled as part of the service. Scheduling Wizard processes the updated rules and rebuilds the affected portion of the call schedule without disrupting the rest of the year. Your program receives an updated schedule rather than spending hours manually reshuffling assignments.
faq.question: What happens when a resident needs a last-minute call schedule change?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard primarily serves chief residents, program directors, program coordinators, and GME offices at residency and fellowship programs. Chief residents benefit most from not having to build or maintain call schedules themselves. Program directors benefit from ACGME compliance confidence and the elimination of annual knowledge loss when chiefs rotate out. Scheduling Wizard is currently serving 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices.
